gap_summary: the shim performs no VC Data Model 2.0 structural validation (it only implements Data Integrity eddsa-rdfc-2022 signing/verifying) -- nearly every failure is a 'missing expected rejection of malformed input' test (bad credentialStatus/refreshService/credentialSchema/termsOfUse/evidence shape, validUntil-before-validFrom, missing type/context, malformed VP). This is a separate, complementary measurement from vc_stage1 (.github/test-suites/vc.yaml), which runs the SAME vendored fixtures directly through VC.Credential.fst's structural checker, no HTTP.

failures.title: Basic Conformance Factoidal A conforming verifier implementation MUST produce errors when non-conforming documents are detected.
failures.message: Missing expected rejection: Failed to reject malformed VP.

failures.title: Contexts Factoidal Verifiable credentials MUST include a @context property.
failures.message: Missing expected rejection: Failed to reject a VC without a missing or incomplete `@context`.

failures.title: Contexts Factoidal Verifiable presentations MUST include a @context property.
failures.message: Missing expected rejection: Failed to reject a VP with a missing @context.

failures.title: Contexts Factoidal Verifiable credentials: The value of the @context property MUST be an ordered set where the first item is a URL with the value https://www.w3.org/ns/credentials/v2.
failures.message: Missing expected rejection: Failed to reject a VC without a missing or incomplete `@context`.

failures.title: Contexts Factoidal Verifiable presentations: The value of the @context property MUST be an ordered set where the first item is a URL with the value https://www.w3.org/ns/credentials/v2.
failures.message: Missing expected rejection: Failed to reject a VP that has the wrong context order.

failures.title: Contexts Factoidal Verifiable Presentation `@context`: "Subsequent items in the ordered set MUST be composed of any combination of URLs and/or objects where each is processable as a JSON-LD Context."
failures.message: Missing expected rejection: Failed to reject a VP with an invalid `@context` URL.

failures.title: Issuer Factoidal The value of the issuer property MUST be either a URL or an object containing an id property whose value is a URL; in either case, the issuer selects this URL to identify itself in a globally unambiguous way.
failures.message: Missing expected rejection: Failed to reject an issuer identifier that was not a URL.

failures.title: Credential Subject Factoidal A verifiable credential MUST contain a credentialSubject property.
failures.message: Missing expected rejection: Failed to rejet a VC without a `credentialSubject`.

failures.title: Credential Subject Factoidal The value of the credentialSubject property is a set of objects where each object MUST be the subject of one or more claims, which MUST be serialized inside the credentialSubject property.
failures.message: Missing expected rejection: Failed to reject a VC with an empty `credentialSubject`.

failures.title: Validity Period Factoidal If present, the value of the validFrom property MUST be an [XMLSCHEMA11-2] dateTimeStamp string value representing the date and time the credential becomes valid, which could be a date and time in the future or in the past.
failures.message: Missing expected rejection: Failed to reject a VC using an incorrect `validFrom` date-time format.

failures.title: Validity Period Factoidal If present, the value of the validUntil property MUST be an [XMLSCHEMA11-2] dateTimeStamp string value representing the date and time the credential ceases to be valid, which could be a date and time in the past or in the future.
failures.message: Missing expected rejection: Failed to reject a VC using an inccorect `validUntil` date-time format.

failures.title: Validity Period Factoidal If a validUntil value also exists, the validFrom value MUST express a datetime that is temporally the same or earlier than the datetime expressed by the validUntil value.
failures.message: Missing expected rejection: Failed to reject a VC with a `validUntil` before its `validFrom`.`

failures.title: Validity Period Factoidal If a validFrom value also exists, the validUntil value MUST express a datetime that is temporally the same or later than the datetime expressed by the validFrom value.
failures.message: Missing expected rejection: Failed to reject a VC with a `validUntil` before its `validFrom`.`
